string.text: Girl, you've got a set on you. Great job.
Ha! You actually did it, you mad bitch! Here, you've earned this, along with my respect.

I've got some real heavy news, girl. One of our Freedom fighters has fallen under the influence of the Monolith. He was a good man, and I know he wouldn't have wanted to continue living as some alien crystal's brainwashed killer. Please, find him and take him down. Otherwise, his old friends are going to have to do it.
Hey, nice job, girl. Here's your money.

Hey girl. Here's a thing. Remember those Sin folks? They didn't get the memo the last time you kicked their collective asses, so I think it's high time for an encore. Loki said they've been spotted being unruly in Zaton, especially around the area of abandoned substation workshops. Go put them down.

Hey girl, stop! I'm the Freedom spy! Sorry for taking potshots at you. I had to keep my cover just in case...luckily you made it. If you bring me to Army Warehouses safely, Lukash will reward you well. Lead the way, I'll follow!
Wow, you actually did it! You lunatic. I'll let the camp know the good news. Glad we have a huntress like you around.
Hey girl. Some of our guys can get a bit too adventurous from time to time. We haven't got enough supplies to treat all of 'em.
Thanks, girl! I knew there was a reason I asked you. You look like a girl who can get shit done.
You keep this shit up, everyone around here is going to love you. Thanks again, girl.
Ha! You absolute mad bitch! Well, go on then. Once you're back with some expert tools, I will show you what a talented mechanic can do.
Girl, Freedom's gonna love this. Shotguns with parachutes! Armoured SMGs! I'll make it happen! Here's your cash, for a job well done.
This ain't summer camp stalker. Be thankful there's people with more guts than you to keep your lot safe.
Good job brothers and sisters, and thanks to all the volunteers that didn't run away. Come back to me for your reward.
Good job brothers and sisters, finally they can rest in peace. Volunteers, come back to me for your reward.
